text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Arima Kinen!! I conquered 
the "dream" race, boss!! With this, I've 
burned through every last spark—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run an even, even more awesome 
race!! And keep showing them...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Show them our "dream"! Show them that we 
are the greatest generation of all!!
